tools.name: search_agencies
tools.description: Search government-licensed domestic-worker recruitment agencies across the six GCC countries (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman). Filter by country, city and/or a free-text name query. Returns contact details, licence information and the official government registry link for each agenc

tools.name: verify_agency_licence
tools.description: Verify whether a Gulf recruitment agency is government-licensed. Look up by agency name, or by licence / facility number (e.g. a UAE MOHRE facility number or Saudi Musaned reference). Returns the licence status recorded on GCC Domestic plus the official government registry link for independent verif

tools.name: search_workers
tools.description: Browse domestic workers currently listed as available through licensed GCC agencies - housemaids, nannies, cooks, drivers and caregivers. Filter by nationality and/or position. Returns public profile info and the agency to contact; hiring always goes through the worker's licensed agency.

tools.name: get_salary_benchmarks
tools.description: Published monthly salary benchmarks for domestic workers in the Gulf, by country and worker nationality. These are the same bands published across gccdomestic.com (salary calculator, 2026 salary report). Currencies: UAE in AED, Saudi Arabia in SAR.

tools.name: get_platform_guide
tools.description: How hiring a domestic worker through GCC Domestic works, with canonical links: country directories, the application page for workers, pricing, and verification guides. Use this to orient before deeper searches, or to hand a user the right link.
